retainedIndependentSummary: Viewed the actual portrait.png and all 18 poses in light.png, dark.png and checker.png at native 1x and the supplied nearest-neighbor 3x. The broad rounded jade shell, gold grooves, long neck, small gold eye, four clawed feet and wave tail remain identifiable. Large upper-left highlights and darker right/underside planes give the shell and limbs volume; the gold and cyan accents remain readable on both backgrounds. No obvious unintended transparent holes, detached limbs or broken exterior outlines are visible. Near feet share the ground line; higher far feet read as depth. Windup retracts the neck and forefoot, move spreads the stride, attack brings the shell forward over the lowered head, and recover restores the upright stance. Idle changes are subtle at 1x. Hit retracts the head; dead visibly collapses the body and splays the feet. Skill preparation gathers cyan energy at the forward shell/neck, skill_b connects the two large water arcs to the open mouth, and skill_c lowers the neck with three residual splashes. Poison has a crouched neck and purple bubbles, stun a drooping bent neck and gold stars, and sleep a lowered shell with tucked limbs and a resting head; these are distinguishable authored-looking states rather than whole-body tints. This is a static pose review: timed continuity, dash speed, actual battle placement, palette/alpha compliance and source authorship cannot be established from these PNGs alone. The recommendation is visual advice, not a user selection.
